client_name: Workflow Modernization (Pega / IBM BAW / Appian / MuleSoft)

review_gates.name: reimagine-review
review_gates.description: Architect sign-off on the Reimagine stage before Blueprint begins

review_gates.name: blueprint-review
review_gates.description: Architect sign-off on the Blueprint (target workflow/data/forms design) before Forward-Engineer begins

review_gates.name: parity-review
review_gates.description: Verify forward-engineered process matches source-platform behavior parity report

governance.notes: Legacy workflow logic (Pega/BAW/Appian/MuleSoft) must be inventoried and behavior-mapped before any forward-engineering. Every generated process must retain an auditable trace back to its source-platform definition and pass a parity review before cutover.
